identity_policy.definition_identity: No JCB entity GUIDs are allocated or encoded in this registry.
identity_policy.runtime_identity: guid and *_guid relationships identify application records unless explicitly labelled command/event identity.
identity_policy.actor_identity: Joomla actor fields use local numeric Joomla user IDs, never runtime record GUIDs or definition GUIDs.
identity_policy.business_identity: Codes, numbers, tags and provider identifiers are separately scoped business keys.

interpretation.fields: Minimum logical design fields. Bind names/types to real JCB Fields and the reused native feature; do not submit this JSON to JCB.
interpretation.common_fields: Common contracts add fields explicitly to entities that declare them; optional Joomla metadata is conditional on the generated model.
interpretation.relations: Relations describe application row links and owner policy, not JCB definition graph links or automatic SQL foreign keys.
interpretation.scope: Scope may be direct farm/enterprise fields or derived from a named owning parent. Derived scope must be resolved and enforced server-side; null never implicitly grants all farms.
interpretation.source_versions: Pinned research revisions are evidence; select current compatible stable runtime at build time.

logical_types.uuid: Canonical immutable application UUID string; unique/indexed as declared.
logical_types.joomla_user_id: Local numeric Joomla user identity; preserve historical actor evidence.
logical_types.decimal_quantity: Exact decimal, proposed DECIMAL(20,6); apply unit/product scale and range.
logical_types.decimal_money: Exact posted money in supported currency precision; calculation and rounding follow finance policy.
logical_types.decimal_rate: Exact positive rate, proposed DECIMAL(24,12), direction/date/source retained.
logical_types.decimal_conversion_factor: Exact positive conversion factor/rational; never a binary float.
logical_types.utc_instant: UTC instant with original local context where required.
logical_types.business_date: Calendar business/accounting date, never a fabricated midnight event timestamp.
logical_types.structured_snapshot: Versioned schema-controlled immutable or controlled metadata; not permission to hide independently persisted child entities in JSON.

id.description: Local Joomla numeric primary key; never a portable cross-installation identity.

guid.description: Application row GUID. This registry contains no allocated JCB definition GUIDs or runtime values.

organisation_guid.description: Installation legal-entity scope; organisation itself is the scope root and does not inherit this self-link.

created_by.description: Local numeric Joomla actor ID. For an automated/imported operation without a human user, preserve explicit service/import attribution in the command/audit evidence; never substitute a definition GUID.

modified_at.description: Last permitted mutation instant; absent for an append-only row after creation.

modified_by.description: Local numeric Joomla modifying actor; does not identify a JCB authoring record.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version on mutable aggregates/rows, checked and advanced by the owner command.

access.description: Optional generated Joomla access metadata; never substitutes for farm/record scope.

asset_id.description: Optional local Joomla ACL asset identity. Never copy source-site asset IDs into portable runtime seed data.

rules: GUIDs identify runtime rows, not JCB definitions.
Keep GUIDs immutable and uniquely indexed within each entity.
Natural business keys retain their separate scope and lifecycle.
Resolve every business relationship within the installation legal entity.
Core is the only owner of organisation records.
Retain provenance for imported data separately from the acting Joomla user.
Historical actor references must not cascade-delete business records when an account is deleted.
Check expected version against original mutation input.
Children changed through an aggregate require the applicable parent version/lock as well.
Inspect actual compiler-generated columns.
Do not assume Joomla Table/asset mutations participate safely in a posting unit of work.

master_crud.description: Owner-managed native CRUD with server validation, scope and historical-reference restrictions.

restricted_master_crud.description: Master CRUD with additional private-field permissions and minimised selectors/exports.

approved_configuration.description: Versioned configuration; approval/effective-date controls and immutable used versions as required.

protected_reference.description: Controlled reference data; changes cannot invalidate historical snapshots.

security_administration.description: Explicitly authorised security/scope changes with immediate server enforcement and audit.

command_aggregate.description: Owner command controls transitions, version checks, invariants and transaction participation; generic mutation endpoints denied where unsafe.

command_child.description: Owner aggregate command controls child lifecycle and parent ownership; no independent bypass via generic child CRUD.

draft_then_posted.description: Draft may be edited through approved owner paths; posting freezes financial/stock effects. Corrections are linked new effects.

draft_child_then_immutable.description: Draft parent permits controlled edits; final/used/posted parent makes these rows immutable.

confirmed_append_only.description: Draft capture may be corrected; confirmation freezes facts. Corrections append an amendment or reversal under the domain contract.

append_only.description: Insert immutable evidence/effect through the owner command; no edit/delete/trash/copy path. Corrections append linked rows.

locked_projection.description: Command-maintained authoritative concurrency projection; update under the same owner locks and transaction as source effects. Rebuild only under a tested writer-exclusion/swap protocol.

idempotency_ledger.description: Durable terminal command result committed atomically with effects; same key returns the same result, conflicting payload is rejected.

outbox_workflow.description: Committed event identity/payload immutable; delivery lease/retry metadata changes through the controlled worker protocol.

staging_workflow.description: Staging/validation state only; applying a row uses the real domain command and its idempotency rules.

approval_workflow.description: Explicit request/decision lifecycle, scope/role thresholds, retained decisions and configured separation of duties.

system_workflow.description: Controlled integration/export/reconciliation state with version, provenance and deduplicated retry.

global_invariants: Each entity has exactly one owning component.
No satellite writes another owner table directly.
All business writers in a command share one tested driver instance and outer transaction.
Cross-component references use application identities; compilation definition GUIDs are a separate ledger.
Every GUID relationship is indexed and resolved through same-organisation and applicable scope checks.
Historical references use restriction/archive policy; uninstall never cascades through other components or erases protected records.
Reference descriptors do not claim the selected JCB compiler emits foreign keys automatically.
Scope, immutable-state and revision rules apply equally to UI, API, import, bulk action, child editor and worker paths.

rules: Source type is an allowlisted entity name; resolve its component owner from this registry.

invariants: Independent quality/recall/legal/other holds; every applicable active hold enforced; releasing one never clears another; overlapping holds/reservations do not subtract the same unavailable units twice
At least one product, lot, warehouse or bin scope is required. Supplied dimensions must agree; a bin belongs to its warehouse and a lot to its product.
whole_scope blocks all matching units; a lot-scoped whole_scope is a whole-lot hold. identified_quantity requires a positive exact quantity, unit and explicit distinguishable partition.
If partial affected units cannot be distinguished reliably, use the whole matching lot/scope until the allocation semantics are proven.
An applicable hold is active and within its half-open effective interval. Every applicable active hold must be enforced at reservation, dispatch, consumption and sale-release boundaries.
Unavailable units are the union of hold-restricted units and reservation commitments. Overlapping whole-lot holds and reservations never subtract the same units twice.
Releasing one hold changes only that hold. Other quality, recall, legal or other holds remain effective.
Manual release requires authorised actor, release time, reason and the required evidence. Release and affected availability checks use the Ledger owner command and locks.

source.minimum_fields_prose: lot/product/location scope, reason/source, whole-lot or identified quantity scope, effective interval, active/released status, release actor/evidence
